boundary.description: The one REST read netlify.anonymous-static-site/v1 depends on: GET /api/v1/sites/{site_id} on https://api.netlify.com. The anonymous deploy itself never reaches this boundary — it has no credential to call it with, which is the point of that path — so every interaction here is post-claim verification or observation.
boundary.secretHandling: The claim URL is bearer authority over a live site and never appears in a request, a response, or a record; the token below is the claiming account's own, shown redacted.

interactions.description: the claiming account reads the site and it resolves to that account: the ownership fact a claim has to move
a credential with no standing over the site is forbidden, not absent: losing read access is evidence the site moved
an unclaimed anonymous project is gone after the documented one hour window: absent, which maps to CLAIM_EXPIRED rather than a generic not-found
a site response carrying no owning account fails closed: a verification that cannot compare ownership must not pass
